segments.name: EMC
segments.description: Aggregates and processes used metals for recycling into new steel-based products, selling recovered metal and steel.
segments.evidence: EMC - Aggregator and processor of used metals for recycling into new steel-based products for the recovery and sale of recovered metal and steel.

revenueModel.text: Buyers pay the company for scrap steel materials it aggregates and sells, mainly recovered metal and steel.
revenueModel.evidence: From inception to date the majority of company activities and revenue have been focused on the aggregation and sales of scrap steel materials.

changes.text: In 2025 the company spun off its American Infrastructure and ReElements segments, which are now discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2025 the Company spun-off of the American Infrastructure and ReElements segments.
